message.content: {"reachable":true,"rationale":"A valid attack sequence is phish_workstation → pivot_internal → auth_ciserver → escalate_ciserver → leak_secrets_ciserver → auth_db → escalate_db → exfiltrate_db. Phishing provides foothold_workstation and stolen_user. Segmentation is not deployed, so the attacker can pivot internally. User MFA and CI-server patching are not deployed, allowing CI access and escalation. CI secrets yield stolen_dbadmin; database-admin MFA is not deployed, so database authentication and escalation succeed, enabling exfiltration. The deployed admin MFA and laptop patch do not block this path."}
